Structures

This structure refers to these other structures:

  • AT ELGA e-Medikation Timing (https://fhir.hl7.at/elga/emed/r4/StructureDefinition/at-elga-emed-timing)
  • SimpleQuantity (http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/SimpleQuantity)

Extensions

This structure refers to these extensions:

  • https://fhir.hl7.at/elga/emed/r4/StructureDefinition/at-elga-emed-extension-dosage-category

Slices

This structure defines the following Slices:

  • The element 1 is sliced based on the value of Dosage.asNeeded[x]
  • The element 1 is sliced based on the value of Dosage.doseAndRate.dose[x]
  • The element 1 is sliced based on the value of Dosage.doseAndRate.rate[x]
